Dear {business_name} Team,

Greetings from GetHotelStays.

I’m reaching out because we would love to onboard {business_name} onto GetHotelStays — our hotel booking and travel platform helping travellers discover and book stays across India.

We’re currently expanding our hotel network and would be excited to have your property join us.

• ₹0 Onboarding Fee
• ₹0 Monthly / Subscription Fee

“Interested”

and our team will share the onboarding process and next steps.

We’d be happy to get {business_name} live on GetHotelStays.
